releaseTitle: Hotspot Manager v1.10.6 - Real Remaining Quota & Time on Used Vouchers
releaseNotes:
• 📊 REAL USAGE ON USED VOUCHERS: when a customer activates a voucher, uses part of their data/time and leaves the network, the Vouchers card now shows the TRUE numbers instead of the full package — e.g. "120 / 768 MB • 648 MB left" and "⌛ 23h 30m left" (continuous-countdown remaining time works offline too).
• 🔍 Customer Quota lookup now also shows the real Time Remaining.
• ♦️ Truly exhausted vouchers still show 100% consumed.
• 🔒 v1.10.5 preserved: readable sales hero card, total vouchers card, long-term voucher protection.
